CONFIG.reference-mapping.json: Reference file used by new_stock.py. Correctly maps yFinance key names to FMSLite key names.
CONFIG.report-portfolio.json: Portfolio health report maintained and used by merger.py module during pre and post data updates. Defines portfolio and stock health standards and is used to self diagnose and warn user in case of data corrupgion.
CONFIG.settings.json: Settings file used to define default and modified values which I used for calculating metrics and price tables within the Financial Modeling Shell Lite application.
CONFIG.template-portfolio.json: Template file used by new_stock.py and a few other helper modules as a source of truth for the structure (DNA) of current and new stock entries within portfolio.json.
CONFIG.template-report.json: Template file used by merger.py as a source of truth for the structure (RNA) of current and new health report entries within report-portfolio.json.

CACHE.latest-newborn.json: Temporary output file created by new_stock.py which holds data for a new entry waiting to be merged into portfolio.json.
CACHE.latest-reborn.json: Temporary output file created by incubator.py which holds targeted update data for an existing entry waiting to be updsted into portfolio.json.
CACHE.latest-refresh.json: Temporary output file created by incubator.py which holds batch data for all portfolio entries waiting to be merged into portfolio.json.

DOCUMENTATION.yfinance-info-pvt.json: File holding raw data fetched from yFinance.info for a random private company.
DOCUMENTATION.yfinance-info-plc.json: File holding raw data fetched from yFinance.info for a random public company.
DOCUMENTATION.yfinance-news.json: File holding raw data fetched from yFinance.news for a random private/public company.

paginator.py.ABOUT: Menu paginator module written in python for internal use.

LIB.merger.py: Utility script called by both new_stock.py and update_portfolio.sh which is tasked with diagnosing, maintaining, updating and verifying the portfolio data and health.
LIB.reporter.py: Termux based news feed script currently used by development team.
LIB.verifier.py: Utility script called by new_stock.py for new ticker symbol and company names search

incubator.py.ABOUT:
Main engine for fetching singular or batch data from yFinance.

Has two main branches one of which splits into a sub-branch.

Outputs three different files deoending on ymthe branch chosen, then calls merger.py wirh the relevant flag for a pre merger/update health scan.

updata.sh.ABOUT: Manual portfolio update file executed via CLI for full portfolio update.

DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.index.html: Financial Modelling Shell Lite's html file for the web app hosted on github pages.
DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.main.py: Python based portfolio manager and task delegator. This is the entry point for portfolio maintenance and updates.
DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.script.js: JavaScript based file which is the brains and nervous system to the html skeleton that makes up the FMSLite web app.
DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.style.css: CSS based file which acts as the superficial skin that holds the skeletal and inner systems of the FMSLite web app that defines physical beauty of the final product.
